items.title: Some under-25s should get less benefits, Milburn review to say
items.summary: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.

items.title: Author says there were 'real concerns' about David Walliams within publishing industry
items.summary: The comedian denies allegations of sexual misconduct, inappropriate behaviour and abusing his power more than 10 years ago.

items.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
items.summary: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

items.title: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
items.summary: Following a ceremony marking Veterans Day, a group that included Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth was shouted at to be quiet.

items.title: Are max strength cold and flu pills worth the money?
items.summary: Some cold and flu remedies cost 20 times as much as a basic pack of paracetamol or ibuprofen.

items.title: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
items.summary: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.

items.title: Thousands of schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

items.title: Significant drop in levels of toxic 'forever' chemicals in England's rivers
items.summary: The decline has been put down to severe restrictions placed on the substances' use.
